name: Seikon ~Inbou Uzumaku Byoutou de Tadareta Soukanzu~
original_name: 性痕 ～淫謀うずまく病棟で爛れた相関図～
source:
Hospital is engulfed in conspiracy. Chairman and director parties oppose each other. Main character is a new doctor, so he soon becomes an object of fierce confrontation with the use of even prohibited means of competition.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-may-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
医院被阴谋笼罩。理事长派与院长派彼此对立。主人公是一名新医生，很快便因双方甚至动用被禁止的竞争手段，成为激烈冲突的对象。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-may-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
